map.：速度翻倍，动能变为 4 倍；速度单位必须用 m/s（km/h 需 ÷3.6 换: : doubling the speed makes kinetic energy 4 times larger; the speed unit must be m/s (km/h needs dividing by 3.6).
map.速度单位必须是 m/s 吗？: Must the speed unit be m/s?
map.是。若手头是 km/h，先除以 3.6 得到 m/s 再输入。: Yes. If you have km/h, divide by 3.6 to get m/s before entering.
map.为什么速度影响这么大？: Why does speed matter so much?
map.因为动能与速度平方成正比，速度小幅增加会显著放大能量。: Because kinetic energy is proportional to the square of speed, a small speed increase amplifies energy markedly.
